title: Aspire Gotek Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The Aspire Gotek Pro Pod Kit is a sleek, compact, and highly portable MTL (Mouth To Lung) vaping device designed for vapers who prioritize convenience and performance. The Gotek Pro sports an elegant design and pocket-friendly size, making it an ideal companion for vapers who are always on the move. At the heart of this kit lies a powerful 1500mAh built-in battery, robust enough to sustain a full day's worth of vaping. This impressive battery capacity, combined with a power output ranging from 13-16W, ensures that the Gotek Pro delivers a consistently satisfying vaping experience throughout the day. Whether you're commuting, working, or simply enjoying a leisurely day out, this kit is designed to keep up with your lifestyle. The Gotek Pro Pod Kit also includes multiple safety and protection features, ensuring a safe vaping experience. The built-in Aspire ASP chipset provides protections such as overcharge protection, short circuit protection, and overheat protection, among others. One of the most user-friendly aspects of the Gotek Pro is its auto-inhale activation feature. This feature allows for a seamless vaping experience without the need for buttons or complex settings – simply inhale from the mouthpiece to activate the device. The lack of buttons not only adds to the sleek design of the kit but also makes it incredibly easy to use, especially for those new to vaping. The Gotek Pro kit comes equipped with a 2ml pod, featuring a convenient side-filling design. This design makes refilling the pod with your favourite e-liquids a breeze, reducing the chances of spills and leaks. The pods are compatible with a variety of e-liquids, but we recommend pairing them with 50/50 , Nic Salts , or High-PG E-Liquids for optimal performance. Each pod houses a fixed 0.8ohm mesh coil, which delivers rich flavours and a super-smooth throat hit, characteristic of the MTL vaping style. The mesh design of the coil enhances the surface area, ensuring e-liquids are heated evenly and efficiently, resulting in a more flavourful and enjoyable vape. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
